// diagnostic

E1221

`package.jet` has a malformed `authority:` block.

What

`package.jet` has a malformed `authority:` block.

Why

`authority: { holds: { allow: […], deny: […] }, grants: { "dep": […] }, trust: { … }, providers: { … } }` is the one package authority block; rights use the thirteen grantable roots, the `FFI` parent and its language leaves including `FFI.Go`, `FFI.Py`, and `FFI.Octave`, and deny-only `Panic`/`Mem`.

Fix

Fix the authority field or right name; see docs/spec/syntax-decisions.md D-AUTHORITY-MANIFEST1.
